title: CM-PharmE v2.1 — tested content-identity proposals and archived detector catalogue
execution_note: Two proposed predicate identity rules tested in isolation; 20 archived detectors executed on their historical sample; three families have bounded positive/negative probes. No scientific gate or domain disposition finalized.

goal_proposed_fa: هدف پیشنهادی CM-PharmE v2.1، مدل مفهومی مرجع و ماژولار برای پیوند سازمان‌ها و نقش‌ها، محصولات و تأسیسات، ثبت و مجوز و نظارت، عرضه و دسترسی و وابستگی‌های تأمین با شواهد زمان‌مند و قلمرومند است. چهار دامنه ریسک، فارماکوویژیلانس، معماری کسب‌وکار و سامانه‌های دیجیتال در وضعیت حفظ برای بررسی‌اند تا با نیازمندی و روابط موجه، سهم حداقلی و قابل ارزیابی در کل مدل داشته باشند. استقلال از کشور هدف طراحی است؛ اعتبار در همه کشورها ادعای اثبات‌شده نیست.

decisions_proposed_not_approved.four_domain_deferral: SUPERSEDED: final removal/transfer on hold by explicit user direction. Evaluate minimum viable retained modules; core versus extension placement still open.
decisions_proposed_not_approved.regulator: Reuse RegulatoryAuthorityRole and grounded authority roles; GovernedEntity is regulated entity, not regulator.
decisions_proposed_not_approved.registry: Existing EstablishmentRegistration is a regulatory relator; Dataset/SourceRecord/IdentifierAssignment provide partial information support, not proof of full registry coverage. Digital component is not synonymous with registry.
decisions_proposed_not_approved.regulatory: Candidate gap: traceable legal document/provision/requirement applicability, jurisdiction and validity; keep bounded. No full legal compliance reasoning claim.
decisions_proposed_not_approved.global: Reusable across selected varied jurisdictions within declared scope, not universal completeness of pharmaceutical ecosystem.
decisions_proposed_not_approved.isolates: Requirement-supported connection or documented deferral, never artificial edges for a connectivity score.
decisions_proposed_not_approved.vvEAA: Exact project-specific definition/source could not be recovered in this turn; no invented expansion. Map supplied framework to release gates when available.

hypothetical_four_domain_class_removal.note: Historical counterfactual only, not a recommendation or implemented change; user has put removal/transfer on hold.

current_adapter_blockers.note: Overlapping categories; recalculate after scope changes.

test_principles: Independent requirements and expected outcomes before model-driven fixture generation
Multiple simultaneous roles for one organization; role changes over time
Jurisdiction-scoped permissions and statuses; no automatic global disjointness
Repeated relators over different time periods; tuple/context uniqueness
Registration versus authorization versus registry record
Incomplete evidence versus actual violation under OWL open-world semantics
Positive concrete-class instantiation, relation coverage, negative fixtures and mutation sensitivity
SQL constraints and synthetic data complement but do not replace OntoUML semantics, OWL reasoners, SHACL and expert review
Global coverage matrix must retain out-of-scope areas to avoid denominator manipulation
